title: Choose Side Quest's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Splits Board. Keep it, take Impeccable's pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Splits Board
options.lineage: speedrunners' split timers: one row per segment, results coloured gold, ahead, behind
options.thesis: The role is the run: each ask is a split, the evidence is the result, and the side quest is the one split to practise.
options.viewport: Run-green header with the role and a large '8 / 10 asks' counter; the asks set as a splits table (ask, evidence path, result word); the one unrun split highlighted as the side quest to practise.
options.risk: Splits normally mean time against rivals: it must never read as a race between candidates or a time score. Translated onto a light ground for a daytime desk review, never black-and-neon.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: the run counter is the one large figure; boxes and outlines go.
One row grammar at every scale: the same split row is the list item, the detail row and the proof-page line.
Importance on a fixed ramp: each ask's weight is drawn as a consistent bar length, never hidden.
Stable references: every ask carries a number (A1 to A10) used in the detail, founder view, proof page and Markdown.
Focus the chosen corridor: the selected role stays full size while the list keeps context; nothing shrinks to a miniature.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: a deleted proof link leaves a stamped VOID record; side quests show run and not-run states.

options.label: Scouting Report
options.lineage: the talent scout's report card: tool grades, measurables, the scout's notes, 'projects as'
options.thesis: Hiring is scouting: every role gets a scout's card for the candidate, graded tool by tool with the evidence as the scout's notes.
options.viewport: A scout card per role: header fields (role, company, 'projects as'), then a tool-grade row per ask with a four-step scale and the scout's note citing the file.
options.risk: The obvious metaphor for a hiring product, so it is where most runs would land; grade scales can drift into scoring people instead of evidence.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.thesis: Proof strength as a live type axis.
options.viewport: One huge glyph with an axis slider over a glyph grid.
options.risk: A type showcase, not a review tool.
options.case: Fuses poorly: reviewers do not identify with type specimens, and the evidence becomes ornament.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: A pixel headline over dense justified columns.
options.risk: Retro novelty on a credibility product.
options.kept: One form repeated at every scale.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Candidates as stars, proof strength as magnitude.
options.viewport: A chart plate of roles with candidates plotted by strength.
options.risk: Dot sizes are less exact than file-level reasons.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it trades exact evidence for atmosphere.

options.label: Catalogue Sleeve
options.thesis: Every artifact gets a catalogue number.
options.viewport: A fac-numbered index as the only map.
options.risk: Codes replace words, hiding the evidence.
options.case: Fuses poorly: names become codes the reviewer must decode.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Asks as stations, roles as lines.
options.viewport: Roles drawn as coloured lines through skill stations.
options.risk: An over-metaphor for a review task.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the map is harder to read than the list it replaces.
options.kept: Focus the chosen corridor, keep context.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Proof links as coupons in a wallet.
options.viewport: A coupon per role link, the network link as the wallet.
options.risk: Costume of a paper ticket on a working screen.
options.case: Loses on audience; nearly holds clarity for the share flow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean hiring-tool interface, executed at the level of the best in the category.
canonCard.viewport: Left role list, right detail with a match summary, evidence cards and actions.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other hiring tools by design.
